integrity: Proof is analytic; independent numerical quadratures and root brackets are reproducible. Priority comparison is best-knowledge, not independently certified.
scientific_limitations: First-harmonic linear response about the nonmagnetic incoherent state only; not a nonlinear stability or finite-population theorem. OU kernel, positive D, tau, mu and beta_s. No bounded-switching-cost constraints.
title: Unique switching optimum and sharp memory-duration boundary in the colored-noise Ising–Kuramoto response
